name: After § 40
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text: 40a. Expresses concern regarding the ongoing process of granting 6 000 acres of land in occupied Karpasia to Istanbul Technical University; emphasises that such an action raises very serious concerns regarding the attempt to consolidate negative faits accompli in the occupied territories at the expense of the rights of lawful owners and of the prospects of resolving the property issue; notes that, at the same time, the inclusion of a 3 500-acre tract of forest land, as reported in the media, violates EU law regarding the protection of the natural environment;
